segments.name: Zions Bank
segments.description: Geographically defined affiliate bank operating branches in Utah, Idaho and Wyoming under local brand and management.
segments.evidence: Zions Bank, headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, operated 92 branches in Utah, 25 branches in Idaho, and one branch in Wyoming at December 31, 2025.

segments.name: California Bank & Trust
segments.description: Affiliate bank operating branches across California under its own local brand and management team.
segments.evidence: California Bank & Trust, headquartered in San Diego, California, operated 77 branches across California at December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Amegy Bank
segments.description: Affiliate bank operating branches across Texas under its own local brand and management team.
segments.evidence: Amegy Bank, headquartered in Houston, Texas, operated 76 branches across Texas at December 31, 2025.

segments.name: National Bank of Arizona
segments.description: Affiliate bank operating branches across Arizona under its own local brand and management team.
segments.evidence: National Bank of Arizona, headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, operated 56 branches across Arizona at December 31, 2025.

segments.name: The Commerce Bank of Washington
segments.description: Affiliate bank operating in Washington and Oregon under its own local brand and management team.
segments.evidence: The Commerce Bank of Washington ("TCBW"), which also operates as The Commerce Bank of Oregon in Oregon.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Enterprise-level segment providing governance, risk oversight, capital allocation, centralized technology and back-office operations.
segments.evidence: The affiliate banks are supported by an enterprise-level segment—referred to as the "Other" segment— which provides governance and risk oversight, capital allocation, and strategic objectives, and includes centralized technology infrastructure, back-office operations, and certain business lines that are not managed through the affiliate structure.

revenueModel.text: The bank earns net interest income from loans and deposits and noninterest income from banking, capital markets and wealth management services provided to customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Zions Bancorporation, National Association ("Zions Bancorporation, N.A.," "the Bank," "we," "our," "us") is a bank headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, with annual net revenue (net interest income and noninterest income) of $3.4 billion in 2025, and total assets of approximately $89 billion at December 31, 2025.
